# Lonavala & Khandala Tourism

> > Comprehensive tourism guide for Lonavala and Khandala hill stations in Maharashtra's Western Ghats, featuring tour packages, attractions, and travel information from Mumbai and Pune.

This site serves as a complete travel resource for visitors planning trips to the twin hill stations of Lonavala and Khandala, located in the Sahyadri mountain ranges. It covers popular attractions like Bhushi Dam, Tiger's Leap, Karla Caves, and Duke's Nose, along with customizable tour packages for weekend getaways and monsoon tourism.

## Key Topics

- Lonavala hill station
- Khandala tourism
- Western Ghats attractions
- Weekend getaways from Mumbai and Pune
- Monsoon tourism in Maharashtra
- Bhushi Dam
- Tiger's Leap viewpoint
- Karla Caves and Bedsa Caves
- Duke's Nose trekking
- Lonavala Lake and Tungarli Lake
- Tour packages and itineraries
- Temple visits and pooja timings
- Entry fees and visiting hours
- Trekking destinations in Sahyadri
- Local sightseeing tours
